Westgate Entertainment District: Your Complete Transportation Guide

Westgate Entertainment District is the West Valley's premier destination for sports, entertainment, and dining. Home to State Farm Stadium (Arizona Cardinals) and Desert Diamond Arena (concerts, family shows and events), Westgate draws huge crowds for games, shows, and the vibrant restaurant and bar scene.

The short answer: book the vehicle by the hour and skip the lots entirely. A 6-hour Cardinals game day is $750 before tax on a Luxury SUV (6 seats, $125/hr), $870 on an Executive Sprinter (14 seats, $145/hr), or $1,500 on a Party Bus (28 Pax) — about $54 per person with 28 aboard.

Understanding Westgate

The Venues

State Farm Stadium

  • Parking: Massive, but overwhelming

The Transportation Challenge at Westgate

Event Day Reality

Arizona Cardinals Game Day:

  • Tens of thousands of fans converging simultaneously
  • Parking lots open hours before kickoff
  • Post-game gridlock can exceed 2 hours
  • The rideshare fare is whatever the app says at the curb
  • Frustration often ruins the experience

Major Concerts:

  • Similar crowds to football
  • Later start means darker parking-lot navigation
  • Varied end times create unpredictable exits

Arena Shows & Smaller Events:

  • More manageable but still big crowds
  • Parking easier but still time-consuming
  • Weekend shows compete with Westgate nightlife

Why Professional Transportation

Avoid the Parking Nightmare:
No searching for spots, no remembering lot letters, no post-event maze navigation.

Know the Price Before You Ride:
A rideshare fare is set when you request the car. Our hourly rate is quoted in writing when you book.

Tailgate Properly:
Drop-off at the tailgate area, pickup when the party ends — you're not the designated driver.

VIP Treatment:
Curbside arrival at the event entrance versus hiking from a far lot.

Navigating Event Logistics

Optimal Pickup Zones

State Farm Stadium:

  • Pre-game: drop near the main entrance lots
  • Post-game: pickup at the designated rideshare/limo zone
  • Coordination text 30 minutes before departure

Desert Diamond Arena:

  • Pre-show: Westgate curbside drop-off
  • Post-show: meet at the designated zone on the west side of the plaza
  • Easier navigation than football games

Timing Strategy

For Football:

  • Arrive 3+ hours early for the full tailgate experience
  • Or arrive 30 minutes before kickoff for just the game
  • Depart immediately at the final whistle for the fastest exit
  • Or stay 30-45 minutes for crowds to thin

For Concerts:

  • Arrive 1 hour before doors for good positioning
  • Or arrive 15 minutes before showtime for seats
  • Know the approximate set end time (we track this)

For Arena Shows:

  • Arrive 30 minutes before start
  • Depart immediately for the easiest exit
  • Westgate bars are good post-show options
